name: Telemetry::record

test_list.description: ModelRequestCompleted adds prompt, completion and cached tokens, cost and one request to the session totals.
Cache statistics stay 'not reported' (None hit rate) until a request carries cached_tokens > 0; per-model cached is None until then.
DecisionMade feeds the S1 stage and ModelRequestCompleted feeds the S2 stage; count, total, max and percentiles are kept separately.
Counters pinned at u64::MAX stay there, the snapshot reports saturated=true, and nothing panics.
record() counts only in the totals; record_for_model() also fills the per-model table, sorted by model id.
ToolExecutionCompleted ok=false and a non-zero sandbox exit code count as failures; snapshot branches are counted.
Diff approvals/rejections, Proof-of-Done passes/blocks, worker restarts, circuit trips and dead letters each have a counter; every event bumps events_seen.
A latency above the histogram range is clamped in the percentile but kept exact in max_us; total_us saturates; u64::MAX does not panic.
An EventRecord of another session is SessionMismatch and changes nothing.
proptest: for random model-request streams the token, cost and request totals equal the sums of the inputs and the S2 stage count equals the number of requests.
proptest: over arbitrary events with extreme field values no counter decreases between consecutive snapshots and nothing panics.

inputs.name: event
inputs.description: One bus event; an exhaustive match decides its effect on the aggregates.

output_description: Folds the event into the per-session aggregates; counters saturate instead of wrapping.
